product.title: Pepperidge Farm Whole Grain Thin Sliced 15 Grain Bread, 22 oz (Pack of 2)
product.description: At Pepperidge Farm, we believe whole grain breads that are good for you should taste good too! That's why we bake each Whole Grain bread loaf with the right combination of quality ingredients, like the satisfying blend of whole grains in our Thin Sliced 15 Grain bread. Enjoy smaller, thinner slices of Whole Grain bread, always crafted with 100% whole grain flour. Pepperidge Farm Whole Grain breads are a delicious way to help you maintain a healthy lifestyle. Enjoy this multigrain bread with your sandwiches or toast up a slice for breakfast! For us, baking is more than a job. It's a real passion. Each day, our bakers take the time to make every cookie, pastry, cracker, and loaf of bread the best way they know how- by using carefully selected, quality ingredients. Shelf-stable product.
feature_bullets: MULTIGRAIN BREAD: Pepperidge Farm 15 Grain Bread with the perfect touch of sweetness and a satisfying blend of grains
SMART CHOICE: 15 Grain bread with smaller, thin slices have whole grain goodness that tastes great too
100% WHOLE GRAIN FLOUR: Pepperidge Farm Whole Grain bread can help you maintain a balanced healthy lifestyle
